module.purpose: Normalizes unknown thrown values into HTTP-compatible errors with status codes, safe messages, and preserved causes for server responses.
module.summary: This module is the server-side error normalization boundary. It identifies framework, validation, database, payment-provider, application-coded, HTTP, native, string, and unknown error shapes, then maps them to HttpError-compatible responses. It also formats nested validation issues, redacts ordinary errors before exposure, and applies status-code policy for known application error codes and Prisma failures.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable API error responses for booking, payments, scheduling, authentication, and integrations. Failure here can expose sensitive details or return incorrect HTTP statuses to clients.

isZodError (~L19-21): Identifies validation errors by instance or constructor name.
isPrismaError (~L23-25): Identifies known Prisma client database errors.
parseZodErrorIssues (~L27-37): Flattens nested validation issues into a readable message.
getServerErrorFromUnknown (~L39-98): Converts arbitrary causes into normalized HTTP errors.
getStatusCode (~L100-136): Maps application error codes or messages to HTTP statuses.
getHttpError (~L138-141): Redacts an error and wraps it with status metadata.

systemCapabilities: Map domain errors to HTTP statuses

detail.name: hasName
detail.signature: function hasName(cause: unknown): cause is { name: string }
postconditions: Returns true only when cause is truthy, has object type, and the property key "name" exists on the value or its prototype chain; otherwise returns false.
invariants: The check does not verify that the value of the "name" property is a string.
edgeCases: null and other falsy values return false.
Primitive values and functions return false because their runtime type is not object.
Objects without an own or inherited "name" property return false.
Objects with an own or inherited "name" property return true, including when the property's value is not a string.

units.name: getServerErrorFromUnknown

detail.name: getServerErrorFromUnknown
preconditions: The cause may be any JavaScript or TypeScript value.
postconditions: Returns an HTTP-oriented error result for recognized error categories and fallback values.
Recognized TRPC errors use a status code derived from the TRPC error and preserve its message.
Recognized Zod errors produce status code 400 with a message derived from their issues.
SyntaxError and unrecognized values produce status code 500 fallback errors.
String causes are converted to an Error carrying the original string as its cause.
invariants: Error classification is performed in the source order: TRPC, Zod, SyntaxError, Prisma, Stripe invalid request, ErrorWithCode, HttpError, generic Error, string, then fallback.
The function does not mutate the supplied cause.
edgeCases: A TRPCError is converted to an HttpError using getHTTPStatusCodeFromError and the TRPC error message.
A Zod error is converted to status code 400, with its parsed issues as the message and the original cause attached.
A SyntaxError is converted to status code 500 with the fixed unexpected-error support message.
A Prisma error is delegated to getServerErrorFromPrismaError.
A value accepted by stripeInvalidRequestErrorSchema.safeParse is converted through getHttpError with status code 400.
An ErrorWithCode uses its derived status code, message defaulting to an empty string, data, and original cause.
An HttpError is redacted and returned with selected original fields restored, including name, message, cause, URL, status code, and method.
A generic Error is converted through getHttpError using its derived status code.
A string cause is returned as a new Error whose cause is the original string.
Any other value produces a status 500 fallback message containing the value's typeof result.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Unknown values are classified into an HTTP error result; unsupported non-string values receive a status 500 fallback.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns an HttpError-shaped result, except that a string cause is converted to a native Error with the original string as its cause.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an HttpError-compatible object or instance with statusCode and message fields; recognized branches may additionally preserve cause, data, name, url, and method.
